problem:
Given that $det(A)=det(B),$ which of the following elementary row operations transforms matrix $A$ to matrix $B,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & -2 \\ 2 & 8 & -2\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & -2 \\ 0 & -2 & -8\end{aligned}]?
$$

examples.knowledge_point: Identifying a Row Operation Given the Connection Between Two Determinants
examples.problem:
Given that $\det(X)=\det(Y),$ which elementary row operations transforms matrix $X$ to matrix $Y,$ where

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14043178/assets/3692f985d592f9680ca9fbf38991df32c7665ae02c7dae04fec6062e3b62884d.png)
examples.worked_solution:
Since $\det(X)=\det(Y)$, the row operation applied to $X$ must be to add or subtract a multiple of one row to another row. In other words, it is of the form 

$$
R_j := R_j + (k)R_i, \quad i \neq j.
$$

By considering the given row operations that are of the above form, we notice that

$$
\begin{aligned}det(X) & =|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 0 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}| & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{3} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & 2 \\ -1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =det(Y).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
R_2:= R_2 + 3R_3.
$$

feedback.problem: Suppose $A$ is a $5\times 5$ matrix and $det(A)=4.$ The matrix $B$ is obtained from $A$ by applying the elementary row operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+3{R}_{2}$ and ${R}_{2}↔{R}_{3}.$ What is the value of $det(B)?$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's figure out what each operation does to the determinant.

- The operation ${R}_{2}↔{R}_{3}$ involves swapping two rows, so it changes the sign of the determinant to the opposite one.

- The operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+3{R}_{2}$ involves adding a multiple of one row to another row,  so it does not change the determinant.

Therefore, we only have to change the sign of the determinant to the opposite one. Consequently, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B) & =-det(A) \\  & =-(4) \\  & =-4.\end{aligned}
$$
